title: Partner Analytics Overview Response
description: Sign-up, master-partner, and activity summaries for the requested reporting period.

period.description: The inclusive reporting period the summaries cover.

start_date.description: Inclusive start of the reporting period.

end_date.description: Inclusive end of the reporting period.

currency.description: Currency of every amount in this response. Always USD.

has_lifetime_referred_client.description: Whether the partner has referred at least one client over their lifetime, regardless of the reporting period.

signups.description: Clients who signed up through the partner during the reporting period.

total.description: Total sign-ups attributed to the partner.

real_accounts.description: Sign-ups that opened a real account.

first_time_depositors.description: Sign-ups that made their first deposit.

first_time_traders.description: Sign-ups that placed their first trade.

master_partner.description: Sub-partner performance, for a partner who manages other partners.

earnings_occurred.description: Master-partner earnings attributed to the reporting period, in USD.

active_subpartners.description: Sub-partners who were active during the reporting period.

activity.description: Commission and trading activity for the reporting period.

paid.description: Paid partner commission for the reporting period, in USD.

pending.description: Pending partner commission for the reporting period, in USD.

active_traders.description: Referred clients who traded during the reporting period.
